Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.44 stages the E1, E3, E4 and E9 CG chapters with bedtime/next-morning window narration, so their visits open at the actual sleep, closing or morning moment instead of reusing a “just closed / still unlocked” line. CG chapter and finale window dialogue now hand off cleanly, including external-dialogue interruption cleanup, while all narration uses the dedicated banner from 1.43. All 1.43/1.42/1.41/1.40/1.39/1.38 fixes and content remain. 1.44 为 E1《回家》、E3《侍从柜台》、E4《两位老板娘》、E9《第二下》的 CG 章节加入睡前/次晨窗口旁白串场，让夜访和晨图按实际睡前、关门后或开门前的时机进入，不再沿用“刚收摊/还没锁窗”的旧状态。CG 章节与终章窗口对白统一收尾并处理外部对话抢占，旁白继续使用 1.43 的独立横幅。保留 1.43/1.42/1.41/1.40/1.39/1.38 全部内容与修复。简体中文 / English / 日语 / 韩语 (ZH / EN / JA / KO)。
